label: Auditorium A, Niels Bohr Institute (Copenhagen)
note: Readme_NBI_em32_Line.pdf: approx. 126 m3, roughly rectangular, tilted audience floor, furnished with classroom equipment, windows on one side wall; T30 0.80 s at 500 Hz and 0.88 s at 1 kHz; one Dynaudio BM6 loudspeaker at a fixed position; measured 22-23 July 2023. The 504 robot-arm line IRs (line01-03) reach their noise floor about 45 dB below the peak at 1 kHz and about 40 dB below it at 125-250 Hz; the Eigenmike IRs reach it about 70 dB below at 1 kHz. Their T30 at 125 and 250 Hz is therefore mostly empty and they grade B, but their 500 Hz-1 kHz values agree with the readme.
